categories.main_business_segments: 3PEAK INCORPORATED (思瑞浦微电子科技) focuses on the design, development, and sales of analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits. Its main product lines include signal chain chips, power management chips, and mixed-signal chips, serving industries such as automotive electronics, communication, industrial control, consumer electronics, and new energy. The company also expanded into battery management and AC/DC chips through the acquisition of Shenzhen Chuangxinwei Microelectronics Co., Ltd. (创芯微).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs BCD process technology and has developed proprietary core technologies including electrostatic protection, low noise and low drift reference voltage, low offset CMOS amplifiers, high voltage amplifiers, ultra-low power circuits, high precision ADC/DAC, high reliability CAN interface chips, and high voltage isolation technology. It operates a fabless model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries, while maintaining in-house testing capabilities with ISO9001 and IATF16949 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in automotive electronics, communication (including 5G/6G base stations, optical modules, servers), industrial control, consumer electronics, and new energy sectors. The company serves leading global and domestic clients, with products integrated into smart vehicles, AI servers, industrial automation, and battery management systems. The automotive segment accounted for approximately 17% of revenue in 2024, showing significant growth.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Suzhou and offices in Shanghai. It has established localized sales and technical support teams in Singapore, Germany, the United States, South Korea, and Japan to support overseas markets. Its products are sold globally, with a growing presence in international automotive and industrial markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: 3PEAK operates as a fabless semiconductor company, focusing on chip design and development. It outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to upstream foundries and subcontractors, while maintaining midstream testing capabilities through its own testing center. The company collaborates closely with supply chain partners to ensure quality and capacity, building a dual domestic and international supply chain system.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes platform-based development with continuous investment in R&D, focusing on enhancing signal chain and power management product lines, and expanding mixed-signal product portfolios. It emphasizes automotive-grade chip development, high integration, and advanced packaging technologies. R&D expenditure accounted for 47.32% of revenue in 2024. The company also pursues strategic acquisitions to broaden product and market reach, and invests in building in-house testing and manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of semiconductor chips to distributors and direct sales to system integrators and end customers. The company follows a 'distribution-led, direct sales supplemented' model, with sales contracts and shipments recognized upon customer acceptance. It also earns investment income from financial assets and equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: 3PEAK competes with international analog semiconductor giants such as Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Infineon, STMicroelectronics, Renesas, and Microchip Technology. While these competitors have larger product portfolios and global scale, 3PEAK positions itself as a leading domestic analog and mixed-signal chip provider with strong R&D capabilities and growing market share in automotive, industrial, and communication sectors. The company is recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' leader in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, 3PEAK reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.22 billion, an 11.52% increase year-over-year, driven by growth in automotive, optical modules, servers, and industrial markets. However, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 197 million due to pricing pressure, increased R&D and sales expenses, and inventory provisions. Total assets reached RMB 6.2 billion with equity of RMB 5.3 billion. The company maintains a strong cash position and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: 3PEAK emphasizes high-performance, high-quality, and high-reliability analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits tailored for diverse applications including automotive, industrial, communication, and consumer electronics. Its competitive advantages include proprietary core technologies, a broad and deep product portfolio with over 2800 SKUs, strong customer relationships, and a robust quality management system certified to automotive standards. The company also leverages strategic acquisitions and globalized R&D and sales networks to enhance its market position and product offerings.
